Recorded claim:
An address book import browser test sometimes clicked before tab layout and resize completed. tabmail forces layout with selectedPanel.getBoundingClientRect before focus and TabOpen; current code keeps the ordering. The test uses chooseFileType to click a radio and assert it is checked. For new tab event changes, preserve the layout-before-event contract and test interactions immediately after opening.
